composition.choose_location: NCH Xijtapejpeni and NHW Xijtlapejpeni are own-variety singular choose commands, derived independently by removing plural -ca using same-corpus singular/plural work-command contrasts. Each own campa introduces where AN Paint will store, using own quiajocuise and nicajocuis to author singular quiajocuis. Digital storage is the same bounded technical extension already accepted for Save. No invented destination noun or second-person storage allomorph. Full GUI clauses are new authored compositions.
composition.other_images: Each independent sequinoc modifies its accepted whole image noun without invented noun plural morphology. NCH ixkopinali is retained from the Cruzhica/Xochiatipan vocabulary; NHW tlaixkopintli is retained intact from the INALI Huasteca Potosina glossary. Mixed source spelling within a regional locale is disclosed, not silently normalized.
composition.ready: Own titequiti is directly singular in each Philemon1 page; own hueli plus finite present is demonstrated independently. Hueli titequiti means you can work, a functional initial readiness label. It is not a claim an earlier task finished, file was saved or initial construction guarantees interactive readiness.

variety_limits: No NHE or Classical verb imported. Similar ready and modal forms are independently evidenced in each own corpus. NCH tapejpeni and cati versus NHW tlapejpeni and catli are preserved; no relative appears in the actual six strings.

NCH central NT gives ISO/locality region, not a named village. Its grammar is combined with the already accepted intact Cruzhica image noun; older indirect locality classification conflict remains in noun metadata.
NHW NT names Tamazunchale with internal variation; INALI image noun is regionally Potosina without an individual contributor village. No uniform regional dialect or orthography claim.
Only lexical/grammatical material is used from the sources, with no religious/legal source-domain content in the UI. No native-speaker, published-whole-GUI-phrase or runtime/layout certification.

record.kind: Own Navajo sources for the spoiled/damaged-state successor

entries.bibliography: Leon Wall and William Morgan, Navajo-English Dictionary (1958), Navajo Agency Branch of Education
entries.location: right column, above the transitive I ruined it entry
entries.sense: Spoiled, disrupted/out of order or ruined. An interrupted dance is explicitly among the examples, so the entry is not confined to torn sheets or snapped rope.
entries.morphology_control: The selected state/intransitive entry is distinct from the next transitive I ruined it entry. Do not use the latter or assert an agent. The modern primary below fixes the complete selected accent spelling, not reconstructed OCR.

entries.bibliography: An Ancient Scroll Unwrapped / Navajo corresponding article, The Watchtower Study Edition June2019 p31, publisher primary pages
entries.source_locator: first main paragraph, after the account of the fire; browser-readable line47
entries.finding: An explicitly damaged written document is described with the exact complete yíchxǫʼ token. The Navajo then explains inability to read or unroll it, and later successful imaging; the word does not by itself mean irreparable or that all underlying information vanished. Candidate omits the source degree modifier, so it does not assert severe/total damage.
entries.retrieval: Both publisher primary Navajo and English pages freshly opened successfully2026-11-03; no audio/native-speaker consultation claimed.

entries.minimal_exact_phrase: bizaad hadaałtʼé dóó doo yíchxǫʼ da
entries.finding: The same full token is negated in discussion of language handed on with reading/writing. This independently supports non-physical corrupted-state usage, not only bodily or material breakage.
entries.limits: Official publisher URL explicitly contains draft. This is supplementary semantic control, not the sole lexical basis or a native certification.

record.orthography: Retain the complete modern high-i yíchxǫʼ form; U+02BC apostrophe normalized, NFC. Do not silently substitute unaccented yichxǫʼ, non-x yichǫʼ, or transitive yíłchxǫʼ. Wilson tire example and low-tone web variants were investigated but are not the selected spelling authority.
record.explicit_extension: From spoiled/ruined object or information state to invalid stored image snapshot. Own-source supports damage semantics but does not attest a complete GUI sentence.

semantic_findings.reason: The old predicate established only incorrectness. The replacement directly predicates a spoiled or damaged state, with primary support spanning object damage and out-of-order condition. Coupled to the unchanged singular stored-image-copy topic, it diagnoses the invalid auxiliary snapshot rather than the artistic quality of the current picture.
semantic_findings.all_three_emitters_fit: At RasterHistory60 compressed bytes fail the expected SHA256 comparison; at62 imported snapshot magic or dimensions fail; at81 the stored entry header fails before pixel writes in that read invocation. These are bounded failures of the stored image representation. The new state predicate fits all three without requiring known physical tears, a guilty actor or a known damaged-byte position.
semantic_findings.singular_scope: One affected stored image-copy is named. No universal statement about all history/cache members is added.
semantic_findings.undo_scope: Quoted Undo names the existing fallback control/subsystem. It is not a claim that the user clicked Undo; the shared history supports Undo, Redo, gesture rollback and imported history.
semantic_findings.loss_recoverability_limit: Neither irreparable total loss nor recovery success is asserted. Source usage with later imaging rebuts the claim that the word by itself necessarily entails complete information annihilation; it does not prove that this software snapshot can be repaired.
semantic_findings.existence_limit: Import failure deletes its temporary snapshot during cleanup. The topic identifies the representation being diagnosed and is not a promise that it remains available after the exception.
semantic_findings.no_added_guarantees: No canvas preservation guarantee, successful restoration, continued file availability, absence of every possible concurrent mutation, native naturalness, layout, runtime or screenreader certification is made.

source_findings.finding: The right-column selected state entry explicitly denotes spoiled, out-of-order or ruined condition and includes interruption of a dance. It is not confined to physical tearing, snapping or destruction. The adjacent transitive entry means I ruined it and is not the selected form. This semantic entry and its two rasters were inspected directly, not inferred from OCR.

Independent successful publisher-page open via the indexed older /naaltsoos/ route redirected to the packet /magazines/ URL. Navajo line47 contains the exact complete selected high-i form; lines47–48 describe subsequent imaging/readability. The English primary parallel was independently opened. The token can describe a damaged document without entailing that every bit of information is irretrievably lost. The candidate omits the source degree modifier, and makes no severe or total-destruction assertion.
source_findings.retrieval_limit: Two initial direct canonical-URL opens returned cache misses, not access denials. Subsequent indexed publisher-route open succeeded; no reliance on inaccessible page content or a secondary summary is needed.

source_findings.finding: Independently reopened official publisher page uses the same complete form in a negated description of transmitted language with reading/writing. This is supplementary evidence of a nonphysical corruption sense. The URL explicitly contains pgp-draft; it is not treated as a finished linguistic authority or the sole basis for acceptance.

Retain exact modern yíchxǫʼ, including high-tone í, x, nasal ǫ and U+02BC final apostrophe. No unaccented, non-x or transitive variant is substituted. The modern sources supply the exact complete written form; this is not a blend reconstructed from OCR.

Exact comparison proves that the sole raw change from v2 is doo ákótʼée da. to yíchxǫʼ. The already reviewed image-copy, singular stored-relative topic and literal .rgba marker are preserved. Prior topic findings were read and their exact records verified; this receipt does not claim to have freshly re-viewed every older topic-source raster.
